title: CLARO: Clutter Aware Robot Orchestrator for Open-Vocabulary Grasping using VLM Agents

problem.summary: Robots that follow natural-language instructions unlock a wide range of autonomous applications in households, warehouses, and labs.
statements: Robots that follow natural-language instructions unlock a wide range of autonomous applications in households, warehouses, and labs.
Real-world environments are diverse and often heavily cluttered, requiring robots to plan over multiple steps, act, and replan as they work toward a goal.

We present CLARO (CLutter-Aware Robot Orchestrator), a VLM agent that orchestrates a set of perception and manipulation skills: open-vocabulary object detection, segmentation, 6-DoF grasping, and non-prehensile pushing to locate and retrieve a language-specified target in clutter.

CLARO prevents this through long-term memory over past images, tool calls, and reasoning traces; (iii) Manipulation in clutter involves removing obstructions, yet grasping each can be slow or infeasible.
